86	Carriers — 24 lines:
87	- `Vec` 13 (2 header/extends, `asString` 1, `indices` 1, `|self|` 1,
88	  `[i]` 1, `[r]` 1, `+` 1, unary `-` 1, `=` 2, `end` 1, constructor

101	- `Mat Vec` juxtaposition 1 → every linear layer (7 model-level uses).
102	- `Vec Mat` juxtaposition 2 → the attention blend `p V` and `q K^T`.
103	- `^T` 2 → the paper-verbatim attention line.
104	- `-(Vec,Value)` 1 → softmax shift; `/(Vec,Value)` 1 → softmax

106	  `relu` 1, `exp` 1 → pointwise lifts; `concat` 1 → head concatenation.
107

109	function (standing rule 1); one tape node per Σ.

112	this): `Value` object 23, `konst`/`exp`/`log`/`relu`/`SQRT` 7,
113	`Topo`+`backward` 20 = 50 lines. Model level (blocks + Model object) is

115	forward 13.

117	## Deviations, classified (fitness function; classes: implementation gap / design limit / deliberate-with-reason)
118	
119	- **D1 `(x DOT x) / d` parens** — loose `DOT` and `/` have incomparable
120	  precedence (spec `basic/operators/precedence.tex`: precedence is
121	  deliberately a partial order; mult/div have no mixing relation in
122	  `appendices/operators.tex`). **Design limit** (deliberate language
123	  design). Carried finding; not re-probed (two probes + spec citation on

125	- **D2 `d = |x|` binding line in rmsnorm** — **deliberate** (judgment
126	  decision 5): one line so the literature's `d` survives and `|x|` is
127	  not misread as a norm in the headline formula. At attention level the
128	  question dissolves: `d_k` is a Model field.
129	- **D3 `sum(...)` named function for Σ** — the library `SUM` is sealed
130	  to `Number` three ways (expressiveness-review finding 7).
131	  **Implementation/library gap** (revival worklist) AND the standing
132	  rules' preferred default; the genuine `SUM` still folds each Sum
133	  node's forward value (the addends' data are Numbers).
134	- **D4 visible max-shift in softmax** — **deliberate-with-reason**
135	  (judgment decision 4): honest numerics, Karpathy's reference does the
136	  same, softmax(a) = softmax(a−m) is an identity, and the shift is the
137	  *genuine* library `BIG MAX` in the big-operator register the
138	  literature uses for max — the counterpoint to sealed Σ.
139	- **D5 bold 𝐖 instead of italic W₁** — `W_1` lexes as a numeral with
140	  radix specifier `_1` (spec `basic/lexical-structure.tex` §Numerals;
141	  radix 1 is a static error), so italic-capital-subscript is a **design
142	  limit** of the lexical spec; capital+digit (`W1`) renders roman — a
143	  **toolchain (Fortify) limit**. Bold `_W1` → 𝐖₁ is the spec's own
144	  boldface convention and a genuine, prevalent ML register (papers bold
145	  their matrices). Judgment decision 2.
146	- **D6 per-head comprehensions at model level** (K, V, heads in
147	  `forward`) — **deliberate** (judgment decision 7): the literature's
148	  "head₁ … head_h" ellipsis made precise, not hidden behind a `Heads`
149	  carrier.

151	  `^T` definitions — grammatical by design
152	  (`concrete-syntax.tex:921`). **Design limit (known)**; notation layer
153	  only, model level never shows it.
154	- **D8 `h0` renders h₀, literature writes h⁰** — the layer superscript
155	  is not reachable as an identifier form (letter+digit is the spec's
156	  *subscript* idiom). **Design limit (lexical convention)**, accepted;
157	  same choice as every prior rung.
158	- **D9 `opr ^ (self, n: RR64)` — the space is load-bearing in Fortify**
159	  (new finding this session): `opr ^(self, …)` typesets as
160	  `opr` with the whole parameter list superscripted; `opr ^ (self, …)`
161	  typesets correctly, and the interpreter accepts both spellings
162	  (verified: p_merge green, full model golden-green with the spaced
163	  form). **Toolchain (Fortify) wart**, recorded; the .fss and the render
164	  sheet now use the identical spaced spelling.

167	  level is a teaching point (unchanged from v1/paper).

170	  *loose* slash (`precedence.tex`); a *tight* slash (`a/b`, no spaces)
171	  inverts this relation. The model level uses loose slashes throughout.
172	- **Note: `seq` asymmetry** — `sum` keeps `seq(addends)` (FP addition is
173	  not associative; the sequential fold is the reproducibility contract);
174	  `BIG MAX` takes the Vec directly (max is exactly associative, parallel
175	  reduction cannot perturb it). A feature of the exhibit, per tower.

10	   autodiff, char-level tokenizer, 1-layer/2-head transformer (rmsnorm,

21	   The design, per the judgment: the autodiff node is named Value
22	   (Karpathy's own class name -- freeing the letter V for the value
23	   matrix); Value joins the 2012 library's numeric tower twice
24	   (MultiplicativeRing gives juxtaposition, binary minus, zero as trait
25	   defaults; StandardMax opens the genuine library BIG MAX to the tape,
26	   so softmax's stabilizing shift is a real big operator with no .data
27	   leak); vectors and matrices are carrier objects on the library's own
28	   Potemkin rank traits (Rank1 excludes Rank2 -- the exclusion that makes
29	   BOTH juxtaposition directions legal under the spec's Meet Rule,
30	   advanced/overloading.tex; library precedent FortressLibrary.fss:2634,
31	   2641); Vec extends AdditiveGroup, so the residual stream rides on
32	   carrier-level inherited algebra; ^T is a real superscripted postfix

35	   carrier = is defined (HasRank's default makes even x = x false --

58	object Value(var data: RR64, children: List[\Value\], grads: List[\RR64\])
59	       extends { MultiplicativeRing[\Value\], StandardMax[\Value\] }
60	  getter one(): Value = konst(1.0)
61	  getter asString(): String = "" data
62	  var grad: RR64 := 0.0
63	  var visited: Boolean := false
64	  opr +(self, o: Value): Value = Value(data + o.data, <| self, o |>, <|[\RR64\] 1.0, 1.0|>)
65	  opr +(self, c: RR64): Value = Value(data + c, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] 1.0|>)
66	  opr TIMES(self, o: Value): Value =

68	  opr -(self): Value = Value(-data, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] -1.0|>)
69	  opr -(self, c: RR64): Value = Value(data - c, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] 1.0|>)
70	  opr /(self, o: Value): Value =
71	    Value(data / o.data, <| self, o |>,
72	          <|[\RR64\] 1.0 / o.data, (-data) / (o.data o.data)|>)
73	  opr /(self, c: RR64): Value = Value(data / c, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] 1.0 / c|>)
74	  opr /(self, n: ZZ32): Value = self / (n 1.0)
75	  opr ^ (self, n: RR64): Value = Value(data^n, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] n data^(n-1.0)|>)
76	  opr ^ (self, n: AnyIntegral): Value = self^(n 1.0)
77	  opr MAX(self, o: Value): Value = if data >= o.data then self else o end
78	end
79	
80	konst(d: RR64): Value = Value(d, emptyList[\Value\](), emptyList[\RR64\]())
81	
82	exp(v: Value): Value = Value(exp v.data, <| v |>, <|[\RR64\] exp v.data|>)

96	sum(x: Vec): Value = sum(x.xs)

98	object Topo()
99	  var items: List[\Value\] := emptyList[\Value\]()
100	  build(v: Value): () = do

102	      v.visited := true

162	opr juxtaposition(w: Mat, x: Vec): Vec = Vec(<| (r DOT x) | r <- w |>)

196	   softmax(a) = softmax(a - m) is an identity, so the shift changes no
197	   number the mathematics defines. *)

212	   forward returns the logits together with the histories extended by

214	   data too: K and V never contain a future position, so no mask. *)
215	object Model(vocab: ZZ32, nEmbd: ZZ32, nHead: ZZ32, d_k: ZZ32,
216	             _Wte: Mat, _Wpe: Mat, _Wlm: Mat,
217	             _Wq: List[\Mat\], _Wk: List[\Mat\], _Wv: List[\Mat\],
218	             _Wo: Mat, _W1: Mat, _W2: Mat)

221	     in the literature's own line.  K stacks the head's key vectors as
222	     rows, so (q K^T)_j = q DOT k_j. *)
223	  attend(q: Vec, K: Mat, V: Mat): Vec = softmax(q K^T / SQRT d_k) V
224	
225	  (* FFN(x) = W_2 relu(W_1 x) *)
226	  ffn(x: Vec): Vec = _W2 relu(_W1 x)

228	  forward(t: ZZ32, i: ZZ32, kh: List[\Mat\], vh: List[\Mat\])

230	    h0 = _Wte[t] + _Wpe[i]

234	    V = <| ((vh[h]).addRight(_Wv[h] x2)) | h <- 0#nHead |>
235	    heads = <| (attend(_Wq[h] x2, K[h], V[h])) | h <- 0#nHead |>
236	    x4 = _Wo concat(heads) + x1

240	  end
241	end

252

255	
256	goldRows(mi: ZZ32, r0: ZZ32, rows: ZZ32, cols: ZZ32): Mat =

260	
261	goldHeads(mi: ZZ32, nh: ZZ32, hs: ZZ32, cols: ZZ32): List[\Mat\] =

263

265	gauss(std: RR64): RR64 = do

object Vec(xs: List[\Value\])
    extends { Rank1, ZeroIndexed[\Value\], DelegatedIndexed[\Value,ZZ32\],
              AdditiveGroup[\Vec\] }
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # |xs|
  opr |self| : ZZ32 = |xs|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: Value = xs[i]
  opr [r: Range[\ZZ32\]]: Vec = Vec(xs[r])
  opr +(self, y: Vec): Vec = Vec(<| (u + w) | (u, w) <- self.zip[\Value\](y) |>)
  opr -(self): Vec = Vec(<| (-u) | u <- xs |>)
  opr =(self, y: Vec): Boolean =
    (|xs| = |y|) AND (BIG AND[m <- self.indices] ((xs[m]).data = y[m].data))
end

object Mat(rows: List[\Vec\])
    extends { Rank2, ZeroIndexed[\Vec\], DelegatedIndexed[\Vec,ZZ32\] }
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # |rows|
  opr |self| : ZZ32 = |rows|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: Vec = rows[i]
  opr [r: Range[\ZZ32\]]: Mat = Mat(rows[r])
  addRight(k: Vec): Mat = Mat(rows.addRight(k))

    (|rows| = |y|) AND (BIG AND[i <- self.indices] (rows[i] = y[i]))
end

opr DOT(u: Vec, w: Vec): Value = sum(<| u[m] w[m] | m <- u.indices |>)

opr -(x: Vec, s: Value): Vec = Vec(<| (u - s) | u <- x |>)
opr /(x: Vec, s: Value): Vec = Vec(<| (u / s) | u <- x |>)
opr /(x: Vec, c: RR64): Vec = Vec(<| (u / c) | u <- x |>)
relu(x: Vec): Vec = Vec(<| (relu u) | u <- x |>)

% joins the library tower twice: MultiplicativeRing buys juxtaposition,
% binary minus, zero; StandardMax opens the genuine BIG MAX), the named
% sum whose body is the how-autodiff-sees-Sigma lesson (one n-ary node,
% forward folded by the genuine library SUM, unit local gradients), and
% backpropagation over the reverse topological order.
% From explorations/microgpt2.fss. Regenerate:
%   bin/fortick explorations/fortify/sheet-engine.tic
%   TEXINPUTS=".:$FORTRESS_HOME/Fortify:" latex sheet-engine.tex
%   dvisvgm --no-fonts --exact-bbox -o sheet-engine-light.svg sheet-engine.dvi

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fortify}
\usepackage[active,tightpage]{preview}
\setlength\PreviewBorder{6pt}
\begin{document}
\begin{preview}
`object Value(var data: RR64, children: List[\Value\], grads: List[\RR64\])
       extends { MultiplicativeRing[\Value\], StandardMax[\Value\] }
  getter one(): Value = konst(1.0)
  var grad: RR64 := 0.0
  var visited: Boolean := false
  opr +(self, o: Value): Value = Value(data + o.data, <| self, o |>, <|[\RR64\] 1.0, 1.0|>)
  opr TIMES(self, o: Value): Value =
    Value(data o.data, <| self, o |>, <|[\RR64\] o.data, data|>)
  opr -(self): Value = Value(-data, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] -1.0|>)
  opr /(self, o: Value): Value =
    Value(data / o.data, <| self, o |>,
          <|[\RR64\] 1.0 / o.data, (-data) / (o.data o.data)|>)
  opr ^ (self, n: RR64): Value = Value(data^n, <| self |>, <|[\RR64\] n data^(n-1.0)|>)
  opr MAX(self, o: Value): Value = if data >= o.data then self else o end
end

sum(addends: List[\Value\]): Value =
  Value(SUM[a <- seq(addends)] a.data, addends, <|[\RR64\] 1.0 | a <- addends|>)

backward(root: Value): () = do
  t = Topo()
  t.build(root)
  root.grad := 1.0
  for v <- seq(t.items.reverse) do
    for (ch, lg) <- seq(v.children.zip[\RR64\](v.grads)) do
      ch.grad := ch.grad + lg v.grad
    end
  end
end`
\end{preview}
